description: PAID $5 USDC. Signed (HMAC-SHA256) webhook POSTs for hack-tracker attacker moves, Binance hourly net outflows and whale transfers into/out of Binance wallets, each with as-of time and block. Returns subscription_id, manage_token and signing_secret (shown once). Returns JSON subscription_id, manage_token, and signing_secret, each shown once.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chains.description: Optional comma-separated chains. Format: the slugs the tool text names: ethereum, bsc, base, tron, bitcoin. Example: ethereum,base. Omit for every chain.

min_usd.description: Minimum USD size of one alert. Format: a number of US dollars. Example: 1000000. Defaults already stated on the tool: hack 100000, whale 1000000, binance_flows 50000000.

topics.description: Comma-separated topic list. Format: hack, binance_flows, whale, in any combination. Example: hack,whale. Default: all three, as the existing tool text states.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the signed alert POSTs. Format: https:// host and path. Example: https://example.com/hook. Required.

name: alerts_subscribe_week
title: Webhook alerts for 7 days ($5)
